topics.title: Articles (a/an/the)
topics.explanation: A/an dipakai untuk satu benda yang belum spesifik (an sebelum bunyi vokal). The dipakai untuk benda yang sudah spesifik atau sudah disebut sebelumnya. Tanpa artikel untuk nama umum jamak dan benda abstrak.
topics.formula: a/an + kata benda tunggal  /  the + kata benda spesifik

examples.en: I saw an elephant at the zoo.
examples.id: Saya melihat seekor gajah di kebun binatang.

examples.en: The book on the table is mine.
examples.id: Buku di atas meja itu milik saya.

topics.title: There is/are
topics.explanation: There is dipakai untuk satu benda (singular), there are untuk banyak benda (plural). Bentuk negatif: there isn't / there aren't. Pertanyaan: Is there...? / Are there...?

topics.title: Prepositions of Place & Time
topics.explanation: In untuk tempat besar dan bulan/tahun (in Jakarta, in May). On untuk permukaan dan hari/tanggal (on the table, on Monday). At untuk titik spesifik dan jam (at home, at 7 o'clock).
topics.formula: in + kota/bulan/tahun  /  on + hari/tanggal  /  at + jam/tempat spesifik

examples.id: Buku itu ada di atas meja.

topics.title: Plural Nouns
topics.explanation: Kata benda jamak biasanya tambah -s atau -es (box → boxes, watch → watches). Kata berakhiran konsonan + y berubah jadi -ies (baby → babies). Beberapa kata tidak beraturan: child → children, man → men, foot → feet.

topics.title: Pronouns & Possessives
topics.explanation: Subject pronoun (I, you, he, she, it, we, they) jadi subjek kalimat. Object pronoun (me, him, her, us, them) jadi objek. Possessive adjective (my, your, his, her, our, their) selalu diikuti kata benda; possessive pronoun (mine, yours, his, ours, theirs) berdiri sendiri.
topics.formula: Subject: I/he/she  /  Object: me/him/her  /  Possessive: my/his + noun

topics.explanation: Will dipakai untuk keputusan spontan, janji, dan prediksi umum. Going to dipakai untuk rencana yang sudah diputuskan dan prediksi berdasarkan bukti yang terlihat sekarang.

topics.title: Comparatives & Superlatives
topics.explanation: Comparative membandingkan dua hal (bigger than), superlative membandingkan tiga hal atau lebih (the biggest). Adjective pendek tambah -er/-est, adjective panjang pakai more/most, dan ada yang tidak beraturan: good → better/best, bad → worse/worst.
topics.formula: short adj + -er/-est  /  more/most + long adj  /  good → better/best

topics.title: Countable/Uncountable & some/any/much/many
topics.explanation: Countable nouns bisa dihitung (apple, book) dan punya bentuk jamak. Uncountable nouns tidak bisa dihitung (water, money, information) dan tidak punya bentuk jamak. Many/much untuk kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan; some untuk positif; any untuk negatif dan pertanyaan.
topics.formula: many + countable  /  much + uncountable  /  some (+)  /  any (-/?)

examples.id: Tidak banyak air di dalam botol.

topics.title: First Conditional
topics.explanation: First Conditional dipakai untuk situasi nyata yang mungkin terjadi di masa depan. Polanya: if + Present Simple, will + verb-1. Urutan klausa bisa dibalik (will... if...).

topics.explanation: Adverb of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) biasanya diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama, tetapi setelah to be. Adverb of manner (slowly, carefully, well) biasanya di akhir kalimat dan dibentuk dari adjective + -ly.

If it ___ tomorrow, we would stay at home. (rain)
If I were you, I ___ apologise. (apologise)
She would travel more if she ___ more money. (have)
If we lived in London, we ___ English every day. (speak)

typing.q: If he ___ harder, he would be the best. (train)
I would help you if I ___. (can)
If they ___ earlier, they would catch the bus. (leave)
If I knew the answer, I ___ you. (tell)
She would be happier if she ___ her job. (like)
If you ___ me, what would you say? (be)

topics.title: Passive Voice (dasar)
topics.explanation: Passive dipakai bila pelaku tidak penting atau tidak diketahui. Bentuknya: to be + verb-3. Present Simple passive: is/are + verb-3. Past Simple passive: was/were + verb-3.

examples.en: The room is cleaned every day.
examples.id: Ruangan itu dibersihkan setiap hari.

examples.en: This book was written in 1990.
examples.id: Buku ini ditulis pada tahun 1990.

mc.q: The room ___ every day. (clean)
This car ___ in Japan. (make)
The letter ___ yesterday. (send)
English ___ in many countries. (speak)
The house ___ in 2010. (build)
The windows ___ by the cleaner every morning. (wash)
The film ___ last year. (watch)
Rice ___ in Indonesia. (grow)

typing.q: The cake ___ by my mother yesterday. (bake)
These shoes ___ in Italy. (make)
The bridge ___ in 2005. (complete)
The homework ___ by the students now. (do)
The thief ___ by the police last night. (catch)
The results ___ tomorrow. (announce)

topics.title: Reported Speech (pengantar)
topics.explanation: Reported speech mengubah kalimat langsung menjadi tidak langsung. Kata kerja biasanya mundur satu tense: Present Simple → Past Simple, Present Continuous → Past Continuous, will → would. Kata ganti dan keterangan waktu ikut berubah.
topics.formula: He said (that) + Past Simple / Past Continuous / would

examples.en: Direct: 'I am tired.' → He said that he was tired.
examples.id: Langsung: 'Saya lelah.' → Dia berkata bahwa dia lelah.

examples.en: Direct: 'I will come.' → She said that she would come.
examples.id: Langsung: 'Saya akan datang.' → Dia berkata bahwa dia akan datang.

mc.q: He said that he ___ tired. (be)
She said that she ___ English. (study)
They said that they ___ come tomorrow. (will)
He told me that he ___ a new car. (buy)
She said that she ___ in Jakarta. (live)
He said: 'I can swim.' → He said that he ___ swim.
Mary said that she ___ her keys. (lose)
He said that he ___ the film yesterday. (watch)

typing.q: She told me that she ___ busy. (be)
They said that they ___ the game. (win)
He said that he ___ to school by bus. (go)
She said: 'I am reading.' → She said that she ___ reading.
He told us that he ___ us. (help)
She said that she ___ her homework. (finish)

topics.title: Relative Clauses (who/which/that)
topics.explanation: Who untuk orang, which untuk benda/hewan, that untuk keduanya, where untuk tempat, when untuk waktu, whose untuk kepemilikan. Klausa ini memberi informasi tambahan tentang kata benda sebelumnya.

examples.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
examples.id: Pria yang tinggal di sebelah adalah seorang dokter.

examples.en: This is the book that I bought yesterday.
examples.id: Ini buku yang saya beli kemarin.

mc.q: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.
This is the book ___ I bought yesterday.
The house ___ we live in is very old.
I know a girl ___ speaks five languages.
The car ___ is parked outside is mine.
Do you remember the day ___ we first met?
The woman ___ bag was stolen called the police.
This is the school ___ I studied.

typing.q: The movie ___ we watched was amazing.
She has a friend ___ father is a pilot.
The book ___ is on the table is mine.
I met a man ___ can speak Japanese.
The year ___ I was born was 2004.
The dog ___ is barking belongs to my neighbour.

topics.title: Modals of Deduction (must/might/can't)
topics.explanation: Must + be/have menunjukkan kesimpulan yang hampir pasti benar. Might/may + be menunjukkan kemungkinan. Can't menunjukkan kesimpulan yang hampir pasti salah. Polanya: modal + be / have + verb-3.

examples.en: She must be tired after the long trip.
examples.id: Dia pasti lelah setelah perjalanan panjang itu.

examples.en: He can't be at home. I saw him at school.
examples.id: Dia tidak mungkin di rumah. Saya melihatnya di sekolah.

mc.q: She ___ be tired. She worked all night.
He ___ be at home. I just saw him at the mall.
It ___ rain later. The sky is cloudy.
They ___ have left already. The house is empty.
She ___ be the new teacher. She looks too young.
He ___ be hungry. He hasn't eaten since morning.
The keys ___ be in my bag. I can't find them.
You ___ have seen him. He was abroad all week.

typing.q: It ___ be true. It sounds impossible.
She ___ have forgotten the meeting. She is usually on time.
He ___ be sleeping. It is very late.
This ___ be the right address. The house looks empty.
They ___ be happy with the result.
She ___ have gone to bed early. She is still online.

topics.title: Gerund & Infinitive
topics.explanation: Beberapa kata kerja diikuti gerund (verb-ing): enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, suggest. Beberapa diikuti infinitive (to + verb-1): want, decide, hope, plan, promise. Beberapa bisa keduanya dengan arti berbeda: stop, remember, try.

examples.en: I enjoy reading books.
examples.id: Saya suka membaca buku.

examples.en: She decided to study abroad.
examples.id: Dia memutuskan untuk belajar di luar negeri.

mc.q: I enjoy ___ books. (read)
She decided ___ abroad. (study)
They finished ___ their homework. (do)
He wants ___ a new car. (buy)
We avoid ___ in the rain. (walk)
She hopes ___ a doctor one day. (become)
I don't mind ___ you. (help)
He promised ___ on time. (come)

typing.q: They suggested ___ a new plan. (make)
She plans ___ English next year. (learn)
Stop ___ so much noise! (make)
I remember ___ my grandmother's house. (visit)
He tried ___ the door, but it was locked. (open)
We need ___ more about this topic. (know)

topics.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
topics.explanation: Present Perfect dipakai bila waktunya tidak disebutkan atau masih berhubungan dengan sekarang (already, just, since, ever). Past Simple dipakai bila waktunya sudah selesai dan disebutkan (yesterday, last year, in 2019).
topics.formula: have/has + verb-3 (waktu tidak disebut)  /  verb-2 + waktu yang disebut

examples.en: I have just finished my work.
examples.id: Saya baru saja menyelesaikan pekerjaan saya.

examples.en: I finished my work yesterday.
examples.id: Saya menyelesaikan pekerjaan saya kemarin.

examples.en: She has lived here since 2020.
examples.id: Dia sudah tinggal di sini sejak 2020.

mc.q: I ___ (finish) my homework yesterday.
She ___ (visit) Bali twice. She loves it there.
We ___ (live) here since 2020.
They ___ (buy) a new car last month.
He ___ (just / eat) lunch.
I ___ (see) that film in 2021.
___ you ever ___ (try) Indonesian food?
She ___ (work) at this school for five years.

typing.q: We ___ (meet) our teacher last Monday.
I ___ (already / read) this book.
He ___ (go) to Jakarta last weekend.
They ___ (not / finish) the project yet.
My brother ___ (graduate) in 2023.
We ___ (know) each other since we were children.

topics.title: Question Tags
topics.explanation: Question tag adalah pertanyaan pendek di akhir kalimat untuk meminta konfirmasi. Bila kalimat positif, tag-nya negatif; bila kalimat negatif, tag-nya positif. Gunakan auxiliary yang sama dan pronoun yang sesuai subjek.
topics.formula: positive sentence + negative tag  /  negative sentence + positive tag

examples.en: You are a student, aren't you?
examples.id: Kamu seorang siswa, bukan?

examples.en: She doesn't like coffee, does she?
examples.id: Dia tidak suka kopi, kan?

mc.q: You are a student, ___?
She likes coffee, ___?
They didn't come, ___?
He can swim, ___?
It is raining, ___?
We have finished, ___?
She won't be late, ___?
They are playing, ___?

typing.q: You don't like tea, ___?
He was at home, ___?
Let's go, ___?
She has a car, ___?
They will come, ___?
I am right, ___?

topics.title: Third Conditional
topics.explanation: Third Conditional dipakai untuk situasi masa lalu yang sudah tidak bisa diubah (penyesalan atau imajinasi). Polanya: if + Past Perfect, would have + verb-3.
topics.formula: If + had + verb-3, would have + verb-3

examples.en: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
examples.id: Jika saya belajar lebih keras, saya pasti sudah lulus ujian.

examples.en: If she had left earlier, she would have caught the train.
examples.id: Jika dia berangkat lebih awal, dia pasti sudah mengejar kereta.

If she had left earlier, she ___ the train. (catch)

We would have arrived on time if the traffic ___ bad. (not / be)

If she had taken my advice, she ___ in trouble now. (not / be)
If they had booked earlier, they ___ cheaper tickets. (get)

topics.title: Mixed Conditionals
topics.explanation: Mixed Conditional menggabungkan kondisi masa lalu dengan hasil di masa kini: if + Past Perfect, would + verb-1. Atau sebaliknya: kondisi masa kini dengan hasil masa lalu: if + Past Simple, would have + verb-3.
topics.formula: If + had + verb-3, would + verb-1  /  If + Past Simple, would have + verb-3

examples.en: If I had saved more money, I would be rich now.
examples.id: Jika saya menabung lebih banyak, saya pasti kaya sekarang.

examples.en: If she weren't so busy, she would have come yesterday.
examples.id: Jika dia tidak sesibuk itu, dia pasti sudah datang kemarin.

If she had studied medicine, she ___ a doctor now. (be)
If he weren't so shy, he ___ the job. (get)
If I had taken that job, I ___ in Jakarta now. (live)
If you had listened to me, you ___ in trouble now. (not / be)
If she spoke English better, she ___ the interview. (pass)
If they had left earlier, they ___ here now. (be)
If I weren't afraid of flying, I ___ to Europe last year. (travel)

typing.q: If he had a car, he ___ to the beach yesterday. (drive)

If they had more experience, they ___ the project. (finish)

topics.title: Passive Voice (lanjut)
topics.explanation: Bentuk passive lanjutan: Present Perfect passive (has/have been + verb-3), modal passive (must/can/should be + verb-3), dan passive dengan dua objek. Fokus tetap pada penerima aksi, bukan pelaku.
topics.formula: have/has been + verb-3  /  modal + be + verb-3

examples.en: The report has been finished.
examples.id: Laporan itu sudah diselesaikan.

examples.en: The documents must be signed today.
examples.id: Dokumen-dokumen itu harus ditandatangani hari ini.

mc.q: The report ___ already. (finish)

The house ___ since 2020. (renovate)
English ___ all over the world. (speak)
The thief ___ by the police. (arrest)

topics.title: Reported Speech (lanjut)
topics.explanation: Pada reported speech lanjutan, perhatikan pergeseran waktu: yesterday → the day before, tomorrow → the next day, last week → the week before, now → then, here → there. Pertanyaan reported memakai kata tanya + urutan kalimat berita (tanpa do/does/did).
topics.formula: He asked where/when/if + subject + verb (urutan berita)

examples.en: He asked me where I lived.
examples.id: Dia bertanya di mana saya tinggal.

examples.en: She asked if I had finished my work.
examples.id: Dia bertanya apakah saya sudah menyelesaikan pekerjaan saya.

She asked if I ___ my homework. (finish)

topics.title: Wish & If only
topics.explanation: Wish + Past Simple untuk keinginan tentang masa kini yang tidak nyata. Wish + Past Perfect untuk penyesalan tentang masa lalu. Wish + would untuk keluhan tentang kebiasaan orang lain atau masa depan.
topics.formula: wish + Past Simple (kini)  /  wish + Past Perfect (lalu)  /  wish + would

examples.en: I wish I had more money.
examples.id: Andai saya punya lebih banyak uang.

examples.en: I wish I had studied harder.
examples.id: Andai saya belajar lebih keras dulu.

mc.q: I wish I ___ more money. (have)
I wish I ___ harder at school. (study)
She wishes she ___ speak French. (can)
I wish it ___ raining now. (stop)
He wishes he ___ the job. (not / lose)
We wish we ___ in a bigger house. (live)

She wishes she ___ the train. (not / miss)

topics.title: Inversion (pengantar)
topics.explanation: Inversion dipakai setelah kata negatif di awal kalimat (Never, Hardly, Rarely, Not only, No sooner) untuk penekanan. Polanya: kata negatif + auxiliary + subject + verb. Dalam bahasa formal, inversion membuat kalimat terdengar lebih kuat.

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
examples.id: Saya belum pernah melihat tempat seindah itu.

examples.en: Hardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
examples.id: Kami baru saja tiba ketika hujan mulai turun.

topics.title: Causative (have/get something done)
topics.explanation: Causative dipakai ketika kita menyuruh orang lain melakukan sesuatu untuk kita. Polanya: have/get + object + verb-3. Have lebih netral, get lebih informal dan menekankan usaha.

examples.en: I had my hair cut yesterday.
examples.id: Saya memotong rambut kemarin (oleh tukang cukur).

examples.en: She got her car repaired.
examples.id: Dia memperbaiki mobilnya (oleh montir).

topics.title: Future Perfect & Future Continuous
topics.explanation: Future Perfect: kegiatan yang akan sudah selesai sebelum suatu waktu di masa depan (will have + verb-3). Future Continuous: kegiatan yang akan sedang berlangsung pada suatu waktu di masa depan (will be + verb-ing).
topics.formula: will have + verb-3  /  will be + verb-ing

examples.en: By 2030, I will have finished my studies.
examples.id: Pada tahun 2030, saya akan sudah menyelesaikan studi saya.

examples.en: This time tomorrow, we will be flying to Jakarta.
examples.id: Besok jam segini, kami akan sedang terbang ke Jakarta.

examples.en: She will have worked here for ten years in June.
examples.id: Pada bulan Juni, dia akan sudah bekerja di sini selama sepuluh tahun.

typing.hint: will have + verb-3 (Future Perfect) atau will be + verb-ing (Future Continuous)

typing.hint: will have + verb-3 (Future Perfect) atau will be + verb-ing (Future Continuous)

typing.hint: will have + verb-3 (Future Perfect) atau will be + verb-ing (Future Continuous)

topics.title: Modals in the Past (must have/could have)
topics.explanation: Must have + verb-3: kesimpulan yang hampir pasti tentang masa lalu. Could have + verb-3: sesuatu yang mungkin terjadi tetapi tidak terjadi. Should have + verb-3: penyesalan atau kritik (seharusnya dilakukan, tetapi tidak).

topics.title: Discourse & Linking (however, although, despite)
topics.explanation: Although/though + klausa (meskipun), despite/in spite of + kata benda/-ing (meskipun), however = tetapi (di awal kalimat dengan koma), because = karena, therefore = oleh karena itu, in addition = sebagai tambahan.
topics.formula: Although + clause  /  Despite + noun/-ing  /  However, + clause

examples.en: Although it was raining, we went out.
examples.id: Meskipun hujan, kami tetap keluar.

examples.id: Meskipun hujan, kami tetap keluar.
